description: Check whether a specific book, film, song, recording or artwork is in the US public domain, and the date it enters it. Use this instead of answering from memory when the work was published 1929–1963 (its status depends on a copyright renewal that models usually don't know), when the work is obscure, or when you need a citable answer before quoting, reprinting, adapting, selling or training on it. Looks up 2.38M US Copyright Office registrations and 434k renewals; a title is usually enough for 1923–1977 books. Returns status, date, confidence, a one-line reason and record IDs, plus a second opinion from HathiTrust's human copyright reviewers and a free-copy link when there is one. Add countries=uk,eu,canada,australia,japan,china,india (or all) to get the answer for those countries in the same call. Not charged if it can't answer. Costs $0.01 (x402, USDC on Base).

countries.description: Also answer for other countries: comma-separated uk, eu, canada, australia, japan, china, india, or all. Same price.

year.description: Year of first publication; inferred for 1923–1977 books when omitted
